description: Workflow for turning a feature or change into a well-scoped ticket for a development team. May read code to understand the system well enough to write a good ticket — but the output is product-level, not an implementation plan. Produces concise tickets focused on the problem, behavior, and acceptance criteria. NOT for reporting a defect (use /write-bug-ticket) and does not implement the change (use /ship).
